data.name: SCP - Containment Breach Reborn
data.detailed_description:
Introduction

SCP - Containment Breach Reborn is an explanation focused horror game with lite survival elements. You assume the role of a class-d personnel trapped by the SCP Foundation. Lacking weaponry, you must employ stealth, problem solving, and quick thinking to make it out alive. The facility houses an array of deadly and uneartly entites known as SCPs. These entities wield powers ranging from reality-bending abilities, to sheer physical destruction, to minor quirks of nature. The ultimate objective is to escape the facility and reach the surface, facing increasingly seemingly insurmountable challenges for any normal human being, and the ever-present threat of SCPs, and those who wish to silence you. This game is a brand new ground-up reimagining of the classic game "SCP - Containment Breach" released in 2012 by Regalis.

Story

Set in 1998, the Foundation is under more strain than ever. Unable to hold up against the constant attacks from a splinter group, the experimental Modular Site Project has been fast-tracked. This site picked for it? 19, a remote research complex primarily dedicated to the study and organisation of SCP data and analityics. The number of specimins being shipped in and the amount of staff displacement are too much, however, and on the morning of the 17th of May, 1998, all hell breaks loose.

Gameplay

SCP - Containment Breach Reborn unfolds within the SCP Foundation facility, currently only featuring a single zone. Your goal is to reach the exit and escape the facility alive, whilst getting past any barriers you may face along the way.

Gameplay mechanics encompass exploration, puzzle-solving, and stealth. Players interact with various objects and structures within the facility, including buttons, gates, and keycards, in order to progress through each zone. Players can also pick up and inspect various items for clues and facility-related information. Inventory management has been refined, featuring a reduced number of slots and a dedicated documents slot or clipboard for efficient organization.

Primary Mechanics

SCP - Containment Breach Reborn is a horror exploration game. The player must navigate through the various zones of the SCP Foundation facility, using a variety of tools and mechanics to survive and achieve their ultimate goal of escape. The following mechanics will be included in the game:

  • Inventory Management: You will have a limited inventory space, with slots dedicated to documents and utility items.

  • Object Interaction: Players will be able to interact with objects in the environment, such as doors, gates, buttons, and items they can pick up and examine.

  • Stealth Mechanics: SCP - Containment Breach Reborn will feature a stealth element, where players must avoid the hostile SCPs or face serious consequences. This creates a sense of tension and danger as you move through the facility, requiring you to be mindful of their actions and surroundings.

  • Puzzle Solving: While SCP - Containment Breach Reborn is primarily a horror exploration game, there will be various puzzles for you to solve along the way. These puzzles will require you to use your problem-solving skills to progress. The puzzles will be designed to be challenging, but not overly difficult, allowing you to focus on the story and progression without halting the game entirely.

SCP Types

The following is a breakdown of the different types of SCPs that you may encounter in SCP - Containment Breach Reborn:

  • Interactable SCPs: These SCPs serve primarily as objects to interact with. They may provide clues, information, or puzzles to solve, but they do not pose a direct threat to the player.

  • Full Experience SCPs: These SCPs are full-fledged experiences, providing unique gameplay scenarios and challenges. They may be more difficult to evade or overcome than other SCPs, but they offer a deeper and more engaging experience for those who are interested.

  • Quests: These SCPs are secondary objectives within the game, often requiring the you to undertake tasks or solve puzzles in order to progress. They may be linked to other SCPs, or exist as standalone experiences.

  • Roaming Threats: These SCPs are unpredictable and often hostile, roaming the zones and presenting a threat to you. They may be neutralized by certain items or mechanics, or simply avoided.

  • Neutral Threats: These SCPs are neutral, not actively pursuing or attacking the player, but still dangerous if provoked. They may have specific requirements or triggers that cause them to become hostile, and the player must learn how to avoid these triggers in order to avoid danger.

data.short_description: Escape the secret facility in SCP - Containment Breach Reborn. Evade anomalies, solve puzzles, and collect items to unlock the path to freedom. Follow the perilous story of D-9341 and uncover the mysteries of the SCP Foundation in this procedurally generated world.
